newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending horizontal trend.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending horizontal trend.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to stay flat on Friday amid its eight-week horizontal trend, following Thursday's mixed continuous trade.
Some analysts said, however, growth was possible as some banks, the bourse's heavyweights, might extend their two-day rise after three months of underperformance.
But others said banks' upside was limited and expected them to dip already on Friday.
Universal might rise, after Thursday's news that its shareholders increased to 11.5 million from 1.5 million zlotys the amount for planned share buy-back. @
Espebepe trade is suspended on Friday as the company's creditors meet to decide on a possible debt-write-off deal. -- Malgorzata Rzepka +48 22 653 9700
